(Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

utv.uk.title: Long Lost Family - Episode One
utv.uk.description: Both stories in this episode celebrate the unique bond between brothers - in our first case, Lee Sharp's adoptive parents had told him that he was a foundling, but the Long Lost Family team discovers that this simply isn't true as the true story leads Lee to a sibling that he never knew he had and with whom he shares so much. In our second case, Peter MacDonald's father snatched him from his mother's arms as a baby as a train carrying her and his older brother Trevor pulled out of Preston station - it was the last time Peter ever saw them, and he longs to see Trevor again after 58 years of missing his big brother. utv.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen - Olly Smith
utv.uk.description: Prue's guest is wine expert Olly Smith. Olly loves nothing more than cooking with wine, and he brings along some bubbles to make a bright and fresh chicken dish - his very own twist on classic one-pot wonder coq au vin. Of course, he and Prue can't resist a good catch up over a glass or two while it cooks! Prue whips up a dark, rich and decadent cake that looks just like its star ingredient: Irish stout. John visits a local stonemason to create a brand-new sculpture for the garden. Prue's food heroes are a couple who fled war in Syria to become cheesemakers in Yorkshire, producing a British take on halloumi. Prue has a quick and easy hack for cooking halloumi cheese with a perfect crispy finish. John joins Prue to make a Hawaiian-inspired dish that's healthy, colourful and delicious - thanks to a lot of hard labour from John. (Documentary) - 2024

utv.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland - South Donegal
utv.uk.description: Dermot heads to the wild west of Donegal to explore the county's Irish-speaking Gaeltacht, where the people, music and food are anything but ordinary. After a crash course at Glencolmcille Folk Village - a living museum celebrating old Irish traditions - Dermot bravely puts his Irish to the test ordering a pint in the local pub. He also discovers an old Irish cure-all: carrageen moss pudding, a surprisingly delicious seaweed dessert said to keep everything from colds to heartbreak at bay. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a pro. He then meets the Shine family, who produce beautifully crafted tinned fish using rare seasonal catches from the Atlantic. Over an unforgettable 'seacuterie' feast, Dermot discovers why Donegal's seafood scene is making serious waves. - 2024

utv.uk.title: DNA Journey - Rob Beckett and Romesh Ranganathan
utv.uk.description: Comedians and best mates Rob Beckett and Romesh Ranganathan embark on a road trip to find out about their family history using a mix of DNA and genealogy and meet family they never knew existed - while there are plenty of belly laughs along the way, there's also some surprising and moving emotion from TV's top funny men. Romesh really wants to connect to his Sri Lankan heritage after growing up in Crawley, while South Londoner Rob is simply hoping that his family aren't all 'wrong'uns' - however, things don't start well for Rob as he finds out his family in the past are well acquainted with the local prison before finding out that his hero ancestor turned the family's fortunes around with some Beckett determination and grit. Meanwhile, Romesh finds out to his joy and horror that he comes from a dynasty of Ayurvedic doctors in Sri Lanka along his paternal line - while expressing pride at what his family achieved from humble beginnings, he worries about his mother Shanthi finding out.. (Documentary) - 2019

bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E5 Week 3 2026 After the excitement of movie week, the celebrities perform for a third time, keen to avoid the fate of Chris Appleton and Amy Dowden, who were the first to be eliminated last Sunday. Hosted by Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe, with Shirley Ballas, Craig Revel Horwood, Motsi Mabuse and Anton Du Beke giving their comments and scores.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Wisdom of the Crowd
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E4 Quiz show hosted by John Bishop in which contestants take on the collective knowledge of the studio audience in a bid to win a potential jackpot of £30,000. According to science, the audience should win and share the money between them. Can any of the hopefuls prove otherwise.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Marble Hall Murders
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E3 Susan digs deeper into the Crace estate with a visit to Eliot's uncle Jonathan, who is very protective of his mother's reputation. But she learns more from Eliot's brother Roland, who confirms that Miriam was a difficult woman, underlining how unreliable a witness Eliot is. In Crete, Atticus and Achilles track Elmer Waysmith's movements on the day his wife died.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Match of the Day : 10/10/2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Gabby Logan presents highlights of the latest Premier League matches, including Arsenal v Leeds United at Emirates Stadium and Manchester United v Tottenham Hotspur at Old Trafford. Champions Arsenal were looking to bounce back from their first loss of the season away to Brighton & Hove Albion just before the international break when they took on a Leeds side that boasted an unbeaten league record so far this term. United had struggled for consistency in the early stages of the campaign, while Spurs went into this round of fixtures at the bottom of the table. Plus, Aston Villa v Brentford, Chelsea v Bournemouth, Ipswich Town v Fulham and Sunderland v Brighton.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Bones and All
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Romantic horror drama starring Taylor Russell, Timothée Chalamet and Mark Rylance. Abandoned by her father, teenager Maren, who has cannibalistic tendencies, sets out to locate her birth mother. She is soon joined by fellow "Eater" Lee, with whom she forms a deep bond. But the pair are also being pursued by another fellow cannibal and may be in grave danger.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Shrek the Third
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Mike Myers, Eddie Murphy and Cameron Diaz. When his father-in-law becomes ill, Shrek is expected to become ruler of Far Far Away. But the grumpy green ogre would rather live the quiet life with Princess Fiona in his beloved swamp. Travelling overseas in search of a true heir, Shrek is unaware that the pregnant Fiona is in danger from a rebellion led by jilted Prince Charming.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Kingdom
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E4 Flint and the Crocodile An injured wild dog needs the support of his pack more than ever before, but in return he helps to care for Storm's largest ever litter of puppies - revealing a new and surprising side to wild dogs. A showdown between mother and daughter sees leopard Olimba struggling to keep a grip on her territory, while the fragmented hyena clan is reuniting and rebuilding their strength.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Homes Under the Hammer
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S28 Too Mushroom on the Ceiling! Jacqui Joseph is not impressed by the mushrooms growing inside a Norfolk end-of-terrace, while Dion Dublin thinks walls need to be rebuilt in a West Midlands property. Martel Maxwell meets a foster father and son who have teamed up to become developers.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Countryfile
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2026 South Pennines Anita Rani and Sean Fletcher head to the South Pennines to join archaeologists and conservationists uncovering the remarkable ways peat is preserving the past while helping to protect the future. Meanwhile, John Craven reveals the winner of this year's Countryfile Photography Competition, for Children in Need.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Reluctant Vampire
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 E2 Val has to come up with a plan to pass the vampire initiation ceremony despite his huge secret. However, his curiosity about human life gets the better of him, and he sneaks to the village, where he bumps into Gertie and is thrust straight into human family life. His two worlds collide when he's invited to a party.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Results
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S24 E6 Week 3 2026 Results Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe present as the two lowest-scoring couples go head to head in the second dance-off of the series. Plus, the professionals show the celebrities how it's done with a group routine.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Antiques Roadshow
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S49 E5 Dartington Estate 2 Fiona Bruce presents the show from Dartington Estate in Devon, where finds include a walking stick with a secret, an African headrest and a Rolex watch rescued from the rubbish. Fiona also explores the history of the estate, home to the Dartington Experiment, which made it a haven for artists, writers and thinkers in the early 20th century.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Time
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S3 E1 When tragedy strikes in the prison, Marie-Louise clashes with veteran officer Bailey, who knows more about the circumstances that led to this major incident than he is letting one. Return of Jimmy McGovern's prison anthology drama, starring David Tennant, with Siobhan Finneran reprising her role as chaplain Marie-Louise O'Dell When tragedy strikes in the prison, Marie-Louise clashes with veteran officer Bailey, who knows more about the circumstances that led to this major incident than he is letting one. Return of Jimmy McGovern's prison anthology drama, starring David Tennant, with Siobhan Finneran reprising her role as chaplain Marie-Louise O'Dell.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Match of the Day : 11/10/2026
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Mark Chapman presents action from the latest Premier League matches, including Liverpool v Manchester City at Anfield. City made the headlines during the international break for off-the-pitch reasons, but will have hoped to keep their 100 per cent record this term intact when they faced the unbeaten Reds. Plus, Crystal Palace v Nottingham Forest, Hull City v Everton and a look back at yesterday's goals.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Nice Guys
bbconemidlands.uk.description: Crime comedy starring Ryan Gosling and Russell Crowe. A burnt-out PI is hired to investigate the death of a porn star but, while navigating the sleazy underbelly of 1970s Los Angeles, he collides with a violent enforcer. After they learn that a missing young woman could be in danger, the two men team up as the mystery develops into a full-blown conspiracy.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Graham Norton Show
bbconemidlands.uk.description: The host reviews trending news stories before welcoming another group of Hollywood A-listers and British TV big shots to his sofa to chat about what they've been up to recently - or whatever else takes their fancy. Plus, music by chart stars and up-and-coming artists and another bunch of intrepid audience members willing to recount an anecdote from the dreaded red chair.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Long Lost Family
itv1anglia.uk.description: S14 E5 Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present a series that aims to help people reunite with long-lost relatives, with investigators picking up the search when the trail has gone cold.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Deal or No Deal
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E60 Amy Stephen Mulhern hosts as Amy gets her chance to take on the Banker. Will she choose to take an offer from the Banker in exchange for what's in her box, or will she bravely hold out until the end and be rewarded.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 The Peak District (30min) James visits the Peak District and is joined by restaurateur Tessa Bramley, who serves him a beef fillet alongside vegetables from her own garden. The chef also meets a local forager and samples his elderflower wine, before using some of the foraged elderflowers to make a delicious dessert.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E24 Joining Alan at Manor Farm are Nigel Havers, Ken Bruce and Lesley Joseph, while horticulturist Camilla Bassett-Smith and carpenter Wayne Perrey talk about garden protection following the drought. Harvest festival tipples are the order of the day in today's Best of British, and there is a celebration of 75 years of Radio 4's The Archers with some of the cast.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E15 Olly Smith Prue's guest is wine expert Olly Smith, who brings along some bubbles to make a bright and fresh chicken dish - his very own twist on classic one-pot wonder coq au vin. Prue whips up a dark, rich and decadent cake that looks just like its star ingredient: Irish stout, while husband John joins her to make a Hawaiian-inspired dish that is healthy, colourful and delicious.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News
itv1anglia.uk.description: E77 10/10/2026 A round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itv1anglia.uk.description: S9 E30 James is joined by actress Joanna Scanlon, who stars in new ITV drama The Party, while Si King and Nick Nairn answer viewers' questions.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
itv1anglia.uk.description: S1 E1 Effortless One Pan Irish chef and author Clodagh McKenna demonstrates the recipes that she loves to cook, beginning with four of her favourite one-pan dishes . She makes broccoli salmon noodles and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta, and shares the tricks to make her pear, thyme and brie tart. She then picks greens from the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she makes in her pickling shed to share with her husband Harry Herbert.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather
itv1anglia.uk.description: E75 10/10/2026 - 1 Round-up of the latest headlines.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV Racing: Live from Newmarket : 10/10/2026
itv1anglia.uk.description: Ed Chamberlin and Francesca Cumani present coverage of a meeting headlined by the Dewhurst Stakes from Newmarket, plus racing from York. With analysis from Jason Weaver and Kevin Blake, reports by Oli Bell and Sally Ann Grassick, and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Jurassic Park III
itv1anglia.uk.description: Science-fiction adventure starring Sam Neill and William H Macy. Dr Alan Grant is persuaded by a seemingly wealthy couple to accompany them on a sight-seeing flight over the dinosaur-inhabited Isla Sorna. But he soon discovers that he has been used as a pawn in a game that will once again bring him face to face with the giant reptiles.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Celebrity Lingo
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E5 Adil Ray hosts the game of words as former EastEnders star Natalie Cassidy and TV host Angellica Bell take on athletes Jonnie Peacock and Greg Rutherford for charity.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
itv1anglia.uk.description: S13 E4 Bradley Walsh presents as Richard Bacon, Daisy Arwen Campbell, Neil Jones and Gary Wilmot pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Win Win
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E3 Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins host the interactive quiz show in which viewers get the chance to win the same prizes as the contestants playing in the studio. Plus, a viewer from last week's show joins Mel and Sue in the studio where contestants face a nail-biting decision: do they take a prize and leave the game, or do they join Millionaire's Row.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Voice UK
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2026 E7 Emma Willis hosts as the battle rounds begin, with coaches Tom Jones, Will.i.am, Kelly Rowland, Tom Fletcher and Danny Jones putting their teams through the toughest challenge yet. Joined by special guest mentors, the coaches prepare their artists for a series of head-to-head performances before making the difficult decision of which three singers from each team will progress to the semi-final.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E6 Festive edition of the comedy game show in which celebrities team up with family members, with the parents choosing which questions their grown-up children will answer and gambling on how many they can get right. Featuring Larry Lamb and his son George, Motsi Mabuse and her mum Dudu, and Josh Widdicombe and his dad Tom competing for charity while, as ever, Romesh's mum Shanthi keeps score and brings extra festive banter.

itv1anglia.uk.title: ITV News and Weather

itv1anglia.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E7 South Donegal Dermot O'Leary heads to the west of Co Donegal for a crash course in the Irish language at Glencolmcille Folk Village, before putting his lesson to the test by ordering a pint in a local pub. Down the road in the fishing town of Killybegs, Dermot gets hands-on with the Molloy family, learning how to fillet monkfish like a professional.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm

Kelvin takes time to reflect on how far they've come since buying the farm five years ago and shares their exciting plans for the year ahead. Lambing gets underway and, after a tricky start, the ewes are producing some of the biggest and healthiest lambs they've ever had.

itv1anglia.uk.description: S8 E25 Actor Michael Brandon, actress Caroline Harker and Antony Costa and Duncan James of Blue join Alan, while Camilla Bassett-Smith takes viewer' gardening questions in Trowels and Tribulations. Rum is the order of the day in today's Best of British, and there is the incredible story of a 15-year-old horse back competing after losing its sight.

itv1anglia.uk.title: EFL Live : Southampton v Portsmouth 11.10
itv1anglia.uk.description: S3 E3 Southampton v Portsmouth (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents all the action from the south coast derby in the Championship, held at St Mary's Stadium. Both meetings between the rivals last term ended in draws, but the Saints will be hoping to maintain their 100 per cent home record this term, as they look to continue climbing up the table after being docked four points at the start of the campaign due to the 'Spygate' scandal. With analysis from Matt Taylor and Francis Benali, commentary by Joe Speight and Iain Dowie, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Cooking with the Stars
itv1anglia.uk.description: S6 E1 Family Favourites Emma Willis and Tom Allen return with the contest as 12 famous faces are each mentored by a chef to compete in culinary battles over 10 weeks. The first head-to-head showdown is between actress Caroline Quentin, Gladiators star Harry Aikines-Aryeetey and Emmerdale actor Mark Charnock as they attempt to deliver classic family favourites. One contestant will go straight through to the next round, while the other two face each other in the dreaded cook off, after which one of them will leave the competition.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Celebrity Lingo
itv1anglia.uk.description: S2 E6 Adil Ray hosts the game of words as Good Morning Britain's Charlotte Hawkins and Sean Fletcher go head-to-head with Cold Feet actors Fay Ripley and John Thomson for charity.

itv1anglia.uk.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
itv1anglia.uk.description: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard. Three years after the catastrophic collapse of the dino theme park, Jurassic World remains abandoned. But when an active volcano threatens the island's surviving dinosaurs, Owen and Claire return to fight an impending second extinction.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Chase
itv1anglia.uk.description: S17 E21 Can Lynwen from Mold, Rob from London, Vikki from Wellingborough and Keith from Manchester work together as a team and take down one of the country's finest quiz brains? Find out as Bradley Walsh hosts and they try to take a Chaser down for thousands of pounds.

itv1anglia.uk.title: The Party

itvborderscotland.uk.title: Unwind with ITV

itvborderscotland.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - Peak District
itvborderscotland.uk.description: James's final stop is in England's first National Park: The Peak District. He is joined by cooking legend Tessa Bramley, who serves him up a delicious beef fillet along with vegetables from her beautiful garden. James takes part in an unusual contest, hen racing, where he challenges a local lad and world champion to a race. After discovering some award-winning gin, James meets a local forager and samples some of his elderflower wine. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvborderscotland.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvborderscotland.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm are Nigel Havers, Ken Bruce and Lesley Joseph. Plus, it's the launch of the Manor Farm puppy school, and horticulturalist Camilla Bassett-Smith and carpenter Wayne Perrey talk garden protection following the drought. Harvest festival tipples are the order of the day in today's Best of British, plus a celebration of 75 years of The Archers with some of the cast. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvborderscotland.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen - Olly Smith
itvborderscotland.uk.description: Prue's guest is wine expert Olly Smith. Olly loves nothing more than cooking with wine, and he brings along some bubbles to make a bright and fresh chicken dish - his very own twist on classic one-pot wonder coq au vin. Of course, he and Prue can't resist a good catch-up over a glass or two while it cooks! Prue whips up a dark, rich and decadent cake that looks just like its star ingredient: Irish stout. John visits a local stonemason to create a brand-new sculpture for the garden. (Cookery, Outdoors) - 2026

itvborderscotland.uk.description: The latest national and international news.

itvborderscotland.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning

itvborderscotland.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - Effortless One Pan
itvborderscotland.uk.description: It's all about effortless and easy one pan wonders as Clodagh shares four all-time favourites. There's broccoli salmon noodles, a perfect 15-minute weeknight supper, and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta that always goes down a storm - both cooked in her lovely outdoor pergola kitchen. Clodagh is sharing the tricks to making her impressive shortcut pear, thyme and brie tart, then picking greens in the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she's making in her pickling shed.

itvborderscotland.uk.title: ITV Racing Live - Newmarket

Clodagh is sharing the tricks to making her impressive shortcut pear, thyme and brie tart, then picking greens in the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she's making in her pickling shed. (Episode, Series)

itvcentralwest.uk.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
itvcentralwest.uk.description: S05E01 We join the Fletchers adjusting to life in their lodge and living back on their land. Plans are in for the farmhouse rebuild following last year's fire, and as they await the green light, there's plenty to keep them busy. Kelvin takes time to reflect on how far they've come since buying the 120 acres five years ago, and shares their exciting plans for the year ahead. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Outdoors, Animals)

itvcentralwest.uk.title: Live: EFL Championship Southampton v Portsmouth ᴸᶦᵛᵉ

itvtynetees.uk.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands - Peak District
itvtynetees.uk.description: James's final stop is in England's first National Park: The Peak District. He is joined by cooking legend Tessa Bramley, who serves him up a delicious beef fillet along with vegetables from her beautiful garden. James takes part in an unusual contest, hen racing, where he challenges a local lad and world champion to a race. After discovering some award-winning gin, James meets a local forager and samples some of his elderflower wine. (Cookery, Entertainment, Travel) - 2020

itvtynetees.uk.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
itvtynetees.uk.description: Joining Alan Titchmarsh at Manor Farm are Nigel Havers, Ken Bruce and Lesley Joseph. Plus, it's the launch of the Manor Farm puppy school, and horticulturalist Camilla Bassett-Smith and carpenter Wayne Perrey talk garden protection following the drought. Harvest festival tipples are the order of the day in today's Best of British, plus a celebration of 75 years of The Archers with some of the cast. (Home improvement, House/garden, Interview) - 2026

itvtynetees.uk.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen - Olly Smith
itvtynetees.uk.description: Prue's guest is wine expert Olly Smith. Olly loves nothing more than cooking with wine, and he brings along some bubbles to make a bright and fresh chicken dish - his very own twist on classic one-pot wonder coq au vin. Of course, he and Prue can't resist a good catch-up over a glass or two while it cooks! Prue whips up a dark, rich and decadent cake that looks just like its star ingredient: Irish stout. John visits a local stonemason to create a brand-new sculpture for the garden. (Cookery, Outdoors) - 2026

itvtynetees.uk.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
itvtynetees.uk.description: James is back in the kitchen with award-winning actress Joanna Scanlon, who is currently appearing in ITV's The Party. Distinguished chefs Si King and Nick Nairn join James to cook and to answer Viewers' Questions.

itvtynetees.uk.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home - Effortless One Pan
itvtynetees.uk.description: It's all about effortless and easy one pan wonders as Clodagh shares four all-time favourites. There's broccoli salmon noodles, a perfect 15-minute weeknight supper, and an all-in-one spicy sausage pasta that always goes down a storm - both cooked in her lovely outdoor pergola kitchen. Clodagh is sharing the tricks to making her impressive shortcut pear, thyme and brie tart, then picking greens in the garden to go in a big warming pot of walled garden soup that she's making in her pickling shed.

E4+1.uk.title: The Simpsons

talkingpictures.uk.title: Edinburgh Royal Mile 1946
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1946. Directed by Terence Egan Bishop. A fascinating travelogue exploring Scotland and the Royal Mile in Edinburgh. (Entertainment) - 1955

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Lucy Show
talkingpictures.uk.description: Lucy and the Monkey. 1966. Stars Lucille Ball, Gale Gordon & Hal March. Lucy is putting in long hours at the office which is leading to some strange hallucinations. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Sherlock Holmes - The Case of the Blind Man's Bluff. 1954. Starring
talkingpictures.uk.description: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. The only clue is a chicken's foot. Insp. Lestrade goes to Sherlock Holmes for assistance. (Crime, Drama, Mystery, Entertainment) - 1984

talkingpictures.uk.title: Hangman's Wharf
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1950. Thriller. Directed by Cecil H. Williamson. Stars John Witty, Genine Graham, Patience Rentoul & Gerald Nodin. A doctor is framed for murder. (Crime, Thriller, Movie) - 1950

talkingpictures.uk.title: Bruce Lee - 2025. Director Enter the Dragon
talkingpictures.uk.description: 2025. Director: Marc Ball. Reflect on how Bruce Lee revolutionised Hollywood, an industry dominated by racial stereotypes. His legacy has redefined roles and paves a new way for Asian actors. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Tell Me Another - True Stories About Colleagues, Past and Present, from the World of Showbusiness
talkingpictures.uk.description: Colleagues, Past and Present, from the World of Showbusiness. 1976. Personal anecdotes as told to Dick Hills. This episode stars Michael Bentine, Bernard Cribbins and Jim Dale. (Entertainment) - 1976

talkingpictures.uk.title: Ghost Town Law
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1942. Western. Directed by Howard Bretherton. Stars Buck Jones, Tim McCoy & Raymond Hatton. When two U.S. marshals are killed, the Rough Riders are sent to a ghost town to hunt down the killers. (Western, Movie) - 1942

talkingpictures.uk.title: Batman
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Entrancing Dr. Cassandra. 1968. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Ida Lupino. Dr. Cassandra has a grand scheme against Gotham City with her invisibility pills merely the beginning of her tricks. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Cheaper By The Dozen - 1950. Comedy. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Walter Lang. Stars Clifton Webb, Myrna Loy, Jeanne Crain & Betty Lynn. Based on a true story. Follow Frank Gilbreth and his wife Lillian, as they raise their 12 children. (Movie)

talkingpictures.uk.title: That's My Boy
talkingpictures.uk.description: Moving Out. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Harold Goodwin. Robert has finally got an opportunity to work in a private practice. The only problem is it means moving to Yorkshire. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Look At Life Action This Day
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1961. An exciting look at the tough training of the Royal Marine Commandos - some of Britain's finest fighting men. (Documentary, Entertainment) - 1961

talkingpictures.uk.title: For the Love of Ada - The Eviction. Stars
talkingpictures.uk.description: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl & Jack Smethurst. Walter and Ada receive notice of eviction as the council intend to build a bypass where their house currently stands. (Comedy, Entertainment) - 1970

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Adriatic Express Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn & Jessie Royce Landis. Solo and Kuryakin ride the Adriatic Express to Venice, seeking a THRUSH virus that could wipe out the human race. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Footage Detectives
talkingpictures.uk.description: Spike Milligan's daughters Jane and Silé visit with reels to share from their father's private archive, they discuss what life was like with Spike and there's exclusive memories from other stars. (Entertainment) - 2021

talkingpictures.uk.title: Enemy At The Door
talkingpictures.uk.description: The Laws and Usages of War. 1978. Stars Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall, Emily Richard. As Clare tells her parents what she did, Kessler's body is found. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Green Man
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1956. Comedy. Stars Alastair Sim, Raymond Huntley, George Cole & Terry-Thomas. A watchmaker turns out to be an assassin whose target is a leading politician but his plans are stalled. (Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 1956

talkingpictures.uk.title: Dial 999
talkingpictures.uk.description: Special Edition. 1958. Stars Robert Beatty, Richard Bennet & Donald Bisset. A gang of career criminals believe they have the perfect alibi when they carry out a payroll robbery in Fleet Street. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Fox
talkingpictures.uk.description: It's All Them Psychia-Whatever-You-Call-It Books He Reads. 1980. Stars Peter Vaughan, Ray Winstone & Bill Nighy. Charlie Locke's failure to regain consciousness turns Kenny's victory sour. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Best of The Adventures
talkingpictures.uk.description: 1981. Comedy. Directed by Stanley Long. Stars Barry Evans, Harry H. Corbett & Diana Dors. The funniest, naughtiest bits from the 1970s Adventures of series. Bawdy British fun at its cheekiest. (Action & Adventure, Drama, Kids, Sci-Fi & Fantasy, Entertainment) - 2007

talkingpictures.uk.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
talkingpictures.uk.description: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview. (Entertainment)

talkingpictures.uk.title: Man In The Attic - 1953. Thriller. Director
talkingpictures.uk.description: Hugo Fregonese. Stars Jack Palance, Constance Smith & Byron Palmer. A landlady suspects her new tenant is Jack the Ripper when a self-described pathologist moves in. (Crime, Movie) - 2023

bet.us.title: Coming to America
bet.us.description: Prince Akeem (Eddie Murphy) is the prince of a wealthy African country and wants for nothing, except a wife who will love him in spite of his title. To escape an arranged marriage, Akeem flees to America accompanied by his persnickety sidekick, Semmi (Arsenio Hall), to find his queen. Disguised as a foreign student working in fast food, he romances Lisa (Shari Headley), but struggles with revealing his true identity to her and his marital intentions to his king father (James Earl Jones). amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six-year-old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1978

amc.us.title: Halloween
amc.us.description: Nearly two decades after being committed to a mental institution for killing his stepfather and older sister, Michael Myers breaks out, intent on returning to the town of Haddonfield, Ill. He arrives in his hometown on Halloween with the indomitable purpose of hunting down his younger sister, Laurie. The only thing standing between Michael and a Halloween night of bloody carnage is psychologist Dr. Samuel Loomis. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2007

amc.us.title: Halloween II
amc.us.description: A year after narrowly escaping death at the hands of Michael Myers (Tyler Mane), Laurie Strode is at the breaking point, pushed to the edge by Dr. Loomis' (Malcolm McDowell) revelation that she's Michael's sister. Little does she know, the unstoppable killer is back in Haddonfield and, driven by visions of their dead mother (Sheri Moon Zombie), he is determined to bring about a bloody family reunion. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2009

amc.us.title: Friday the 13th: Part 7: The New Blood
amc.us.description: Years after the strange drowning death of her father, Tina Shepard (Lar Park Lincoln) returns to the site of his demise, Crystal Lake. Her developing psychic powers were responsible for ending his life, leaving Tina riddled with guilt as an adult. While deceitful Dr. Crews (Terry Kiser) tries to manipulate her abilities for his own ends, both physician and patient are in for a shock when Tina's powers unwittingly free camper-killer Jason Voorhees from his watery slumber. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1988

amc.us.title: Jason X
amc.us.description: The year is 2455. The Place is Old Earth. Once the shimmering blue jewel of the galaxy, Old Earth is now a contaminated planet abandoned for centuries. Yet humans have returned to the deadly place that they once fled. Not to live, but to research the ancient rusting artifacts of the bygone civilizations that caused this environmental disaster. And little does the most recent landing party of intrepid young explorers realize the fate that awaits them. (Horror, Science fiction) - 2002

amc.us.title: Eight Legged Freaks
amc.us.description: The residents of a rural mining town discover that an unfortunate chemical spill has caused hundreds of little spiders to mutate overnight to the size of SUVs. It's up to mining engineer Chris McCormack (David Arquette) and Sheriff Sam Parker (Kari Wuhrer) to mobilize an eclectic group of townspeople into battle against the bloodthirsty eight-legged beasts. (Thriller, Comedy, Science fiction) - 2002

amc.us.title: The Blob
amc.us.description: In a tiny California town, high school students Brian (Kevin Dillon), Meg (Shawnee Smith) and Paul (Donovan Leitch) discover a strange, gelatinous substance that melts the flesh of any living creatures in its path. The deadly substance gets into the town's sewer system, where it begins growing uncontrollably, occasionally emerging to feast on unsuspecting townspeople. A military clean-up crew is sent to eliminate the menace, but it may end up doing more harm than good. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1988

amc.us.title: Leprechaun
amc.us.description: Dan O'Grady (Shay Duffin) steals 100 gold coins from a leprechaun (Warwick Davis) while on vacation in Ireland. The leprechaun follows him home, but Dan locks the murderous midget in a crate, held at bay by a four-leaf clover. Ten years later, J.D. Redding (John Sanderford) and his daughter, Tory (Jennifer Aniston), rent O'Grady's property for the summer. When their new neighbors accidentally release the leprechaun, he goes on a murderous rampage to reclaim his gold. (Horror, Comedy) - 1993

amc.us.title: Gremlins
amc.us.description: A gadget salesman is looking for a special gift for his son and finds one at a store in Chinatown. The shopkeeper is reluctant to sell him the "mogwai" but sells it to him with the warning to never expose him to bright light, water, or to feed him after midnight. All of this happens and the result is a gang of gremlins that decide to tear up the town on Christmas Eve. (Holiday, Fantasy, Thriller, Comedy, Horror) - 1984

amc.us.title: The Fly
amc.us.description: When scientist Seth Brundle completes his teleportation device, he decides to test its abilities on himself. Unbeknownst to him, a housefly slips in during the process, leading to a merger of man and insect. Initially, Brundle appears to have undergone a successful teleportation, but the fly's cells begin to take over his body. As he becomes increasingly fly-like, Brundle's girlfriend is horrified as the person she once loved deteriorates into a monster. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1986

amc.us.title: The Thing
amc.us.description: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one. (Horror, Science fiction) - 1982

amc.us.title: Tremors
amc.us.description: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh. (Horror, Comedy) - 1990

amc.us.title: It
amc.us.description: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise. (Horror, Thriller) - 2017

Eventually, he falls in love with her and must win her over before she gets married. (Romantic comedy) - 1998

comedycentral.us.title: Just Go With It
comedycentral.us.description: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble. fx.us.title: Alice in Wonderland
fx.us.description: A young girl when she first visited magical Underland, Alice Kingsleigh is now a teenager with no memory of the place -- except in her dreams. Her life takes a turn for the unexpected when, at a garden party for her fiancé and herself, she spots a certain white rabbit and tumbles down a hole after him. Reunited with her friends the Mad Hatter, the Cheshire Cat and others, Alice learns it is her destiny to end the Red Queen's reign of terror. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2010

fx.us.title: Alice Through the Looking Glass
fx.us.description: After slipping through a mirror, Alice (Mia Wasikowska) finds herself back in Underland with the White Queen (Anne Hathaway), the Cheshire Cat, the White Rabbit, Tweedledee and Tweedledum. Her friends tell her that the Mad Hatter (Johnny Depp) is in a funk over the loss of his family. Hoping to save his loved ones, Alice steals the Chronosphere from Time (Sacha Baron Cohen) to travel into the past. While there, she encounters the younger Hatter and the evil Red Queen (Helena Bonham Carter). (Fantasy, Adventure, Animated) - 2016

fx.us.title: Hocus Pocus
fx.us.description: After moving to Salem, Mass., teenager Max Dennison (Omri Katz) explores an abandoned house with his sister Dani (Thora Birch) and their new friend, Allison (Vinessa Shaw). After dismissing a story Allison tells as superstitious, Max accidentally frees a coven of evil witches (Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy) who used to live in the house. Now, with the help of a magical cat, the kids must steal the witches' book of spells to stop them from becoming immortal. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

fx.us.title: Avengers: Endgame

Meanwhile, the remaining Avengers -- Thor, Black Widow, Captain America and Bruce Banner -- must figure out a way to bring back their vanquished allies for an epic showdown with Thanos, the evil demigod who decimated the planet and the universe. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Science fiction) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Adult Best Friends
actionmax.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Shazam!
actionmax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
actionmax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: Black Adam
actionmax.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

actionmax.us.title: Flashpoint
actionmax.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action) - 1984

actionmax.us.title: Pan
actionmax.us.description: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. Adventure awaits as he meets new friend James Hook and the warrior Tiger Lily. They must band together to save Neverland from the ruthless pirate Blackbeard. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure, Action) - 2015

actionmax.us.title: Batman
actionmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

actionmax.us.title: Batman Returns
actionmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Batman Forever
actionmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

actionmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
actionmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

actionmax.us.title: Isle of Dogs
actionmax.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Man
actionmax.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Comedy, Action) - 2005

actionmax.us.title: Masterminds
actionmax.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: The Darkest Minds
actionmax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen

abcsydney.au.title: ABC News Mornings ᴺᵉʷ
abcsydney.au.description: E203 Monday 12 October 2026 Stay in the know with what's happening this morning. ABC News brings you up-to-the-minute news to fuel your daily conversations so you can stay connected and follow the discussion across the day. Presented by Gemma Veness.

abcsydney.au.title: Lynley
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E1 A Place of Hiding Mismatched duo DI Lynley and DS Havers investigate a suspicious death on Salcott Island and the mystery surrounding a priceless piece of art which leads which leads them to not one, but two crimes.

abcsydney.au.title: Stuff The British Stole
abcsydney.au.description: S1 E5 The Crow Flies Crowfoot, a Chief of Blackfoot nation, negotiated one of the most controversial treaties in Canadian history and his personal regalia ended up in a British museum. Did colonial forces literally steal the shirt from his back?

cinemax.us.title: Girls Trip
cinemax.us.description: Best friends Ryan, Sasha, Lisa and Dina are in for the adventure of a lifetime when they travel to New Orleans for the annual Essence Festival. Along the way, they rekindle their sisterhood and rediscover their wild side by doing enough dancing, drinking, brawling and romancing to make the Big Easy blush. (Comedy, Drama, Adventure) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Masterminds
cinemax.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Contagion
cinemax.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

cinemax.us.title: Prancer: A Christmas Tale
cinemax.us.description: Ten-year-old Gloria and her recently widowed grandfather Bud befriend a mysterious reindeer when the family gathers for Christmas. Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way. (Family, Holiday, Drama, Fantasy) - 2022

cinemax.us.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
cinemax.us.description: In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today. (Holiday, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Chasing Mavericks
cinemax.us.description: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives. (Docudrama, Adventure) - 2012

cinemax.us.title: Atomic Blonde
cinemax.us.description: Sensual and savage, Lorraine Broughton is the most elite spy in MI6, an agent who's willing to use all of her lethal skills to stay alive during an impossible mission. With the Berlin Wall about to fall, she travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. Once there, she teams up with an embedded station chief to navigate her way through the deadliest game of spies. (Action, Thriller, LGBTQ) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
cinemax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Robin Hood
cinemax.us.description: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

cinemax.us.title: Smoking Tigers
cinemax.us.description: Lonely 16-year-old Korean American Hayoung tries to hide her problematic family and lower-income background from her new wealthy friends. (Drama) - 2023

cinemax.us.title: A History of Violence
cinemax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Cleaner
cinemax.us.description: Hoping to expose corruption, radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. Their cause soon gets hijacked by an extremist within their ranks who's ready to kill everyone. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother. (Action, Thriller) - 2025

cinemax.us.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
cinemax.us.description: After months have passed without a culprit in her daughter's murder case, Mildred Hayes makes a bold move, painting three signs leading into her town with a controversial message directed at William Willoughby, the town's revered chief of police. When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated. (Crime drama, Dark comedy) - 2017

cinemaxwest.us.description: A suburban dad falls hard for his new neighbor. (Comedy) - 2025

cinemaxaction.us.title: Adult Best Friends
cinemaxaction.us.description: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests. (Comedy, Movie) - 2024-06-08

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 2024-03-27

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shazam!
cinemaxaction.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Movie) - 2019-04-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
cinemaxaction.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy, Movie) - 2023-03-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Black Adam
cinemaxaction.us.description: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 2022-10-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Flashpoint
cinemaxaction.us.description: Texas border patrolmen (Kris Kristofferson, Treat Williams) find a jeep, a skeleton and $800,000 in cash dating from 1963. (Action, Crime, Movie, Thriller, Western) - 1984

cinemaxaction.us.title: Pan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. Adventure awaits as he meets new friend James Hook and the warrior Tiger Lily. They must band together to save Neverland from the ruthless pirate Blackbeard. (Action, Adventure, Children, Family, Fantasy) - 2015-07-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman
cinemaxaction.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself "The Joker" (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1989-06-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Returns
cinemaxaction.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie) - 1992-06-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman Forever
cinemaxaction.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Crime, Fantasy, Movie) - 1995-06-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Batman & Robin
cinemaxaction.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy, Movie, Science Fiction) - 1997-06-20

cinemaxaction.us.title: Isle of Dogs
cinemaxaction.us.description: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Action, Adventure, Animated, Comedy, Drama) - 2018-02-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Man
cinemaxaction.us.description: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler, who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2005-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Masterminds
cinemaxaction.us.description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 2016-06-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxaction.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Science fiction) - 2018-08-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Trap
cinemaxaction.us.description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Crime, Horror, Movie, Music, Thriller) - 2024-08-02

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Mountain Between Us
cinemaxaction.us.description: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength. (Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2017-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Contagion
cinemaxaction.us.description: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Drama, Movie, Science Fiction, Thriller) - 2011-09-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Night on Earth
cinemaxaction.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach De Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Drama, Movie) - 1992-04-25

cinemaxaction.us.title: All Eyez on Me
cinemaxaction.us.description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices. Against all odds, Shakur's raw talent, powerful lyrics and revolutionary mindset establish him as a cultural icon whose legacy continues to grow long after his death. (Biography, Drama, Hip-Hop & Rap, History, Movie) - 2017-06-15

cinemaxaction.us.title: Inconceivable
cinemaxaction.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Crime, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2017-06-30

cinemaxaction.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
cinemaxaction.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Comedy, Horror, Movie, Musical comedy) - 1986-12-19

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemaxaction.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy, Comedy drama, Crime, Movie, Thriller) - 1960-08-10

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemaxaction.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2001-12-07

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemaxaction.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2004-12-09

cinemaxaction.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemaxaction.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime, Crime drama, Movie, Thriller) - 2007-06-07
