knwa.us.title: Access Hollywood
knwa.us.description: The 2025-2026 season of "Access Hollywood" marks the 30th year of bringing the biggest Hollywood headlines and celebrity interviews to viewers. The show is hosted by Mario Lopez, Kit Hoover, Scott Evans and Zuri Hall. The Emmy Award-nominated, daily, half-hour syndicated program delivers the inside scoop on the latest breaking entertainment news. "Access" also delves into the latest true crime headlines with insight from leading experts, celebrates local heroes working to make their communities better, and speaks with the people behind the viral moments everyone is talking about. In 2021, "Access Hollywood" was honored at the annual CultureX Conversation Conference with the award for Program Reflection of Inclusion in Television by Multichannel News and Broadcasting + Cable. The award is in recognition of its diverse hosts and coverage of stories about diversity and inclusion in the television industry. (Newsmagazine, Entertainment, Interview) - 1996-09-09

wnyw.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
wnyw.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wnyw.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
wnyw.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

kmss.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

(Reality, Animals, Pets) - 2013-09-28

waka.us.title: The Open Road With Dr. Chris
waka.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. Dr. Chris' commitment to animal care extends to environmental stewardship, and it's with this in mind that he embarks on a journey that sees him taking on exhilarating experiences that range from hiking in a volcano to swimming with humpback whales. waka.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
waka.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. (Reality, Animals, Pets, Docudrama, Adventure) - 2026-10-03

waka.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under ᴺᵉʷ
waka.us.description: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

waka.us.title: Hope in the Wild ᴺᵉʷ
waka.us.description: Wildlife rehabilitation expert Hope Swinimer and her dedicated team rescue and heal injured and orphaned animals of all kinds. Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children. (Reality, Nature, Animals, Educational) - 2018-09-29

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. wnkydt2.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose ᴺᵉʷ
wnkydt2.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals, Pets, Reality) - 2025-10-04

fxm.us.description: Tense tale about a group of men who are left stranded in the middle of the Arabian desert after a plane crash. Their only hope of survival is to rebuild the craft so that, phoenix-like, she may fly again and carry them to safety, but can the captain and navigator calm the passengers as tension mounts and time starts to run out? (Adventure) - 1965

fxm.us.title: An Affair to Remember
fxm.us.description: A man and a woman have a romance while on a cruise from Europe to New York. Despite being engaged to other people, both agree to reunite at the top of the Empire State Building in six months. However, an unfortunate accident keeps her from the reunion, and he fears that she has married or does not love him anymore. (Romance) - 1957

fxm.us.title: The Seven Year Itch
fxm.us.description: In the midst of a summer heat wave, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) ships his wife, Helen (Evelyn Keyes), and their son off to Maine for vacation. Left alone to work back in Manhattan, Richard encounters a gorgeous blonde model (Marilyn Monroe) who has moved into the apartment upstairs, and becomes immediately infatuated. While pondering infidelity, Richard dreams of his beautiful new neighbor -- but will his fantasies about her become a reality? (Comedy) - 1955

fxm.us.title: Will Success Spoil Rock Hunter?
fxm.us.description: Rock Hunter (Tony Randall) writes television commercials, and he's hatched a strategy for a new beauty product. Needing a famous face to deliver his message, Rock tries to recruit actress Rita Marlowe (Jayne Mansfield). At first, she thinks it's beneath her, but she wants to make her actor lover (Mickey Hargitay) envious, so she agrees, as long as Rock pretends to be her boyfriend. Soon, Rock is running the ad company, but his ascension is greeted by all kinds of personal troubles. (Comedy) - 1957

fxm.us.title: Batman
fxm.us.description: Kaaapowie! Holy feature film, Batman ... one based on the tongue-in-cheek, campy 1960s television series. Watch Batman and Robin battle sharks, Catwoman, The Joker and The Riddler on the big screen. Can they try to prevent the bad guys from taking over the world? With a wham! and a pow! and a zip! ... our heroes just might win. (Action, Comedy) - 1966

fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

fxm.us.title: The Watch
fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Unbreakable
fxm.us.description: David Dunn (Bruce Willis) is the sole survivor of a devastating train wreck. Elijah Price (Samuel L. Jackson) is a mysterious stranger who offers a bizarre explanation as to why David escaped without a single scratch -- an explanation which threatens to change David's family and his life forever. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Drama, Science fiction) - 2000

fxm.us.title: Signs
fxm.us.description: Everything that farmer Graham Hess (Mel Gibson) assumed about the world is changed when he discovers a message - an intricate pattern of circles and lines - carved into his crops. As he investigates the unfolding mystery, what he finds will forever alter the lives of his brother (Joaquin Phoenix) and children (Rory Culkin), (Abigail Breslin). A unique story that explores the mysterious real-life phenomena of crop signs and the effects they have on one man and his family. (Thriller, Science fiction, Drama, Mystery) - 2002

fxm.us.title: The Sixth Sense
fxm.us.description: Young Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment) is haunted by a dark secret: he is visited by ghosts. Cole is frightened by visitations from those with unresolved problems who appear from the shadows. He is too afraid to tell anyone about his anguish, except child psychologist Dr. Malcolm Crowe (Bruce Willis). As Dr. Crowe tries to uncover the truth about Cole's supernatural abilities, the consequences for client and therapist are a jolt that awakens them both to something unexplainable. (Thriller, Mystery, Action, Horror) - 1999

5starmax.us.description: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart. (Romantic comedy) - 2005

5starmax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
5starmax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
5starmax.us.description: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian. (Romantic comedy) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: Hall Pass
5starmax.us.description: Best friends Rick and Fred each have been married for a long time, and they are showing signs of restlessness. To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: The Switch
5starmax.us.description: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
5starmax.us.description: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

5starmax.us.title: The Art of Getting By
5starmax.us.description: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix. (Comedy drama) - 2011

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

lafftv.us.description: When Tim's (Tim Allen) first car is junked, Jill (Patricia Richardson) decides to find him an exact replica. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Mr. Likable
lafftv.us.description: Tim has trouble convincing everyone he's happy for Al, who gets a role in a TV movie with Morgan Fairchild. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Thanks, but No Thanks
lafftv.us.description: Tim invites his brother, Marty, who has separated from his wife and twin daughters to move into the Taylor household. (Sitcom, Thanksgiving)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Home for the Holidays
lafftv.us.description: Randy surprises his family when he returns home for Christmas; Tim and Al compete in the neighborhood lighting contest. (Sitcom, Christmas)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Ploys for Tots
lafftv.us.description: Tim gives his newly divorced brother advice regarding twins and tantrums. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Home Improvement - Chop Shop 'Til You Drop
lafftv.us.description: Tim and Al (Tim Allen, Richard Karn) go undercover to find the thieves of Brad's (Zachery Ty Bryan) new car. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Conners - The Publisher Cops Show Pilot
lafftv.us.description: Jackie faces problems at the Lunch Box and must take advice from an unexpected guest; Dan and Darlene take a trip into Chicago. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: The Conners - Shrinks Don't Talk and Kids Don't Sing
lafftv.us.description: Mark adjusts to his first day of college as a commuter student; Becky gets into a disagreement with Beverly Rose's music teacher over a song. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - Pregnancy Brain
lafftv.us.description: Jim tries to convince Cheryl that it was her idea to turn the basement into a media room instead of a room for Gracie and Ruby, blaming her forgetfulness on pregnancy. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The Gift Certificate
lafftv.us.description: Jim uses Andy's gift certificate just before Andy remembers he has it and invites Jim to help him use it. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - I Drink Your Milkshake
lafftv.us.description: Jim institutes a tribunal system to stop the children from bickering, and it works well for solving the children's problems but backfires when he and Andy have an argument. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The Chaperone
lafftv.us.description: After years of dating, Andy meets the perfect girl and worries that she will break up with him; Jim offers to take Andy's girlfriend's daughter to a concert with Ruby and Gracie. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Cabin Pressure
lafftv.us.description: Mike and Vanessa take the girls to the family cabin, where Mike challenges them to unplug for the weekend and stay off their phones; for a school assignment, Jen shadows Kyle at work. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - The Best Man
lafftv.us.description: When Chuck and Carol decide to renew their vows, Mike plans to take his officiating to the next level. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Sibling Quibbling
lafftv.us.description: After Mandy and Kyle combine their finances, they begin to quarrel. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: Last Man Standing - Arrest Her Development
lafftv.us.description: Vanessa "helps" Mandy and Kyle look for their first apartment; Mike is thrilled when Ryan's good business decisions have him unknowingly embracing capitalism. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The Six Week Curse
lafftv.us.description: Andy is sure Emily is going to break up with him, since all his former girlfriends left him after six weeks of dating; Dana hypnotizes Andy to find out the cause of his breakups. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The Cheater
lafftv.us.description: Pregnant Cheryl wants to have a game night and play a game that she never loses, but Dana knows she cheats. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - No Bedrest for the Wicked
lafftv.us.description: A chance meeting in the supermarket lets Jim in on Cheryl's secret: though she says the doctor told her to stay in bed, her doctor actually wants her to be active. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The Devil Went Down to Oak Park
lafftv.us.description: The devil (James Lipton) comes to collect on a deal Jim made with him back when Jim was courting Cheryl. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The Blankie
lafftv.us.description: Jim guilts the older kids into doing household chores after Jonathan's special blanket goes missing. (Sitcom)

lafftv.us.title: According to Jim - The New Best Friend
lafftv.us.description: When Dana, Cheryl's sister and best friend, moves away, Jim realizes he must find Cheryl a new friend as soon as possible. (Sitcom)

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Prayer
greatamericancountry.us.description: Struggling with creative burnout, a children's book illustrator finds unexpected inspiration when she learns about a girl's Christmas wish for her recently widowed father to find happiness again.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Wisconsin Christmas Pie
greatamericancountry.us.description: A pastry chef returns to Wisconsin when she learns her family's farm is on the brink of being sold to developers. Reconnecting with her high school sweetheart, they discover love may just be the recipe for saving the farm -- and their hearts.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas Keepsake
greatamericancountry.us.description: Following their move to a new city, a father bonds with his daughter and stumbles upon an unexpected romance while tracking down the original owner of a Christmas time capsule.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Royal Christmas Tail
greatamericancountry.us.description: A prince swaps a glass slipper for a dog tag in his Christmas search for the woman and her dog who stole his heart during one enchanted holiday encounter.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
greatamericancountry.us.description: A woman receives help from a selfless neighbor when an arm injury puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Castle Proposal
greatamericancountry.us.description: Despite busy schedules causing distance, Olivia and Prince Alexander travel to Torovia for Christmas with his family. Clashing cultures between their families lead to various mishaps.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Crown Prince of Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Madison jokingly tells her overbearing family that she is dating the prince of a small European nation. The joke goes too far as her friend/co-worker Sebastian is roped into impersonating the prince while visiting her family in New Jersey.

greatamericancountry.us.title: My Favorite Christmas Tree
greatamericancountry.us.description: Kyla visits a small town attempting to find her ancestry and meets a Christmas tree farm owner.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
greatamericancountry.us.description: A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of "The Nutcracker."

greatamericancountry.us.title: Have We Met This Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: After a car wreck leaves her with amnesia, a real estate exec recovers at a small town inn at Christmas. Unaware of their past connection, she falls for the innkeeper's son - until her returning memories jeopardize their budding romance.

greatamericancountry.us.title: The Trouble With Christmas Mistletoe
greatamericancountry.us.description: An executive returns home for Christmas and reconnects with the former fiancé she left behind. As the traditions of her hometown rekindle old memories, she begins to wonder if the life she walked away from may still be the one meant for her.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Jingle Bell Princess
greatamericancountry.us.description: After a series of mishaps, sophisticated Princess Amelia becomes stranded in the small town of Tucker Maine, where she becomes a guest of the unsuspecting Cutler family, widowed father Sam and daughter Sophie, but doesn't tell them she's a princess.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Second Chance Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Divorced for five years, Anna and James reluctantly agree to meet their daughter's boyfriend at a rustic cabin. But when an ice storm traps them in the mountains, they're forced to confront the history they share as old feelings resurface.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Blessing
greatamericancountry.us.description: A TV chef is divinely inspired to take over her late aunt's charity with help from a new friend and handsome neighbor.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas Miracle for Daisy
greatamericancountry.us.description: Interior designer Whitney Alder agrees to work for her ex-boyfriend Cormac, who has adopted his orphaned niece, Daisy. Daisy's Christmas wish is for Whitney and Cormac to get together so she can have the mother she always wanted.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Lot Like Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Jessica owns the most popular Christmas tree lot in Hudson Springs, but when big-city marketing executive Clay Moore moves a big box chain store into the area and starts selling trees, Jessica finds her business in jeopardy.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Christmas for the Ages
greatamericancountry.us.description: Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s, and today.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Brush With Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: Disheartened and struggling to find time for her art, Charlotte throws out her latest painting, only to discover that it has been anonymously submitted to the Christmas art festival.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Royal Christmas Holiday
greatamericancountry.us.description: An ambitious reporter tracks down a prince who is in town for the dedication of a naval museum honoring his late grandfather. She convinces him to show his followers that his work is more than just a job, and the two begin to fall for each other.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Angel Falls Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: A devoted doctor with little time for the Christmas spirit is in desperate need of an intervention from the unlikeliest of places.

greatamericancountry.us.title: A Kindhearted Christmas
greatamericancountry.us.description: To capture the holiday spirit, Jaime anonymously gives gifts to those in need. Word spreads and people in town wonder who this "Secret Santa" is. She remains anonymous and meets Scott. Jamie tries to keep her secret and pursue a new romance.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Christmas Under the Northern Lights
greatamericancountry.us.description: A historian seeks inspiration for her next project in her family's hometown, which is famous for experiencing the Northern Lights. While there, she bonds with a local tour guide who shows her the town's Christmas traditions.

greatamericancountry.us.title: Peppermint and Postcards
greatamericancountry.us.description: When 9-year-old Megan dedicates her Christmas wish to helping her mom Cara find love, her letter goes viral. Cara realizes that what she was looking for may have been on her doorstop all along.

fxwest.us.title: Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City
fxwest.us.description: Welcome to Raccoon City, once the booming home of pharmaceutical giant Umbrella Corp. The company's exodus left the city a wasteland, a dying town with great evil brewing below the surface. When that evil is unleashed, a group of survivors must work together to uncover the truth behind Umbrella and make it through the night. (Horror, Action) - 2021

After a catastrophic crash on an unknown planet, pilot Mills quickly discovers he's actually stranded on Earth -- 65 million years ago. Now, with only one chance at a rescue, Mills and the only other survivor, Koa, must make their way across an unknown terrain riddled with dangerous prehistoric creatures. (Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Thriller) - 2023

fxwest.us.title: Jumanji: The Next Level
fxwest.us.description: When Spencer goes back into the fantastical world of Jumanji, pals Martha, Fridge and Bethany re-enter the game to bring him home. But the game is now broken -- and fighting back. Everything the friends know about Jumanji is about to change, as they soon discover there are more obstacles and more danger to overcome. (Adventure, Action, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

fxwest.us.title: Alice in Wonderland
fxwest.us.description: A young girl when she first visited magical Underland, Alice Kingsleigh is now a teenager with no memory of the place -- except in her dreams. Her life takes a turn for the unexpected when, at a garden party for her fiancé and herself, she spots a certain white rabbit and tumbles down a hole after him. Reunited with her friends the Mad Hatter, the Cheshire Cat and others, Alice learns it is her destiny to end the Red Queen's reign of terror. (Children, Fantasy, Adventure) - 2010

fxwest.us.title: Alice Through the Looking Glass
fxwest.us.description: After slipping through a mirror, Alice (Mia Wasikowska) finds herself back in Underland with the White Queen (Anne Hathaway), the Cheshire Cat, the White Rabbit, Tweedledee and Tweedledum. Her friends tell her that the Mad Hatter (Johnny Depp) is in a funk over the loss of his family. Hoping to save his loved ones, Alice steals the Chronosphere from Time (Sacha Baron Cohen) to travel into the past. While there, she encounters the younger Hatter and the evil Red Queen (Helena Bonham Carter). (Fantasy, Adventure, Animated) - 2016

fxwest.us.title: Hocus Pocus
fxwest.us.description: After moving to Salem, Mass., teenager Max Dennison (Omri Katz) explores an abandoned house with his sister Dani (Thora Birch) and their new friend, Allison (Vinessa Shaw). After dismissing a story Allison tells as superstitious, Max accidentally frees a coven of evil witches (Bette Midler, Sarah Jessica Parker, Kathy Najimy) who used to live in the house. Now, with the help of a magical cat, the kids must steal the witches' book of spells to stop them from becoming immortal. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: A Cinderella Christmas
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: At a holiday masquerade ball, fledgling event planner Angie Wells and wealthy playboy Nicholas Karmichael, who needs to marry to retain his inheritance, meet and fall for each other anonymously. While Nicholas tries to locate the girl of his dreams, Angie must choose between pursuing her lifelong dream of running a business or following her heart. (Holiday, Romance) - 2016

greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: Mrs. "Miracle" Merkle (Doris Roberts) helps save a struggling department store during the Christmas season. - 2010

greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: With her career on the line, a decorator must work with an unexpected partner to showcase a house for an upcoming Christmas gala. (Romance) - 2023

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: Christmas in Scotland
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: On vacation in Scotland, a New York installation designer is tasked with helping a small, rural community compete in a "Best Christmas Village" festival. She is forced to work with a wealthy, heir who sees Christmas as an inconvenience. (Holiday, Romance, Comedy, Drama) - 2023

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: The Spruces and the Pines
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: The Spruces and the Pines, rival tree farm-owning families, have been feuding for years. When the respective heirs fall in love, they must keep their growing romance a secret, or they'll risk a Christmas blow-up that could destroy everything. (Holiday, Drama) - 2017

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: A city manager recruits the help of a childhood friend to save his town's Christmas charity event, while she attempts to set him up with her close friend. (Holiday, Romance) - 2023

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: Journey to Christmas
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: A winter storm forces a New York City fashion model to spend the week before Christmas with her chauffeur and his extended family in rural America. (Holiday, Romantic comedy) - 2023

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: Snowmance
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: A true romantic finally gets her chance at the love she's always dreamed of when a little Christmas magic brings her snowman to life. (Holiday, Romance) - 2017

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: A Cozy Christmas Quilt
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: A fireman and a quilting teacher team up to make a Christmas quilt for the former's sister's wedding. As they navigate their feelings for each other, they must decide what is truly important in time for the holiday season. (Holiday, Romance) - 2023

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: I'm Glad It's Christmas
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: An aspiring Broadway singer is convinced to participate in a small-scale production for the local Christmas celebration. (Holiday, Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2022

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: Christmas Wreaths and Ribbons
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: A woman receives help from a selfless neighbor when an arm injury puts her holiday wreath deliveries in jeopardy. (Holiday, Romance) - 2024

greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: Christmas on Every Page
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: A woman returns home for the holidays to help her mother's struggling bookstore. greatamericanfaith&living.us.title: Destined at Christmas
greatamericanfaith&living.us.description: After Kim and Theo meet in the midst of Black Friday shopping madness, they are determined to meet again. (Holiday, Romance) - 2022

hdnetmovies.us.title: Men in War
hdnetmovies.us.description: At the start of the Korean War, Lt. Benson (Robert Ryan) and his platoon are ordered to rendezvous with American forces at Hill 465. showtimewest.us.title: The Bodyguard
showtimewest.us.description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.

showtimewest.us.title: Rock of Ages
showtimewest.us.description: Songs by Def Leppard, Journey, Joan Jett, Bon Jovi and others underscore a rock 'n' roll romance between a small-town girl (Julianne Hough) and a city boy (Diego Boneta) who meet on the Sunset Strip while chasing their Hollywood dreams.

showtimewest.us.title: Edge of Tomorrow
showtimewest.us.description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

showtimewest.us.title: Blade Runner 2049
showtimewest.us.description: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

showtimewest.us.title: The Equalizer 2
showtimewest.us.description: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

showtimewest.us.title: Killer Joe
showtimewest.us.description: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

showtimewest.us.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
showtimewest.us.description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

showtimewest.us.title: Love and Monsters
showtimewest.us.description: A young man and his traveling companions battle an array of monsters during an 80-mile journey to find the woman he loves.

showtimewest.us.title: Ghost in the Shell
showtimewest.us.description: A one-of-a-kind, cyber-enhanced soldier (Scarlett Johansson) must battle a new enemy who can hack into people's minds and control them.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
showtimewest.us.description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
showtimewest.us.description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
showtimewest.us.description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

showtimewest.us.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
showtimewest.us.description: Indy (Harrison Ford) and a young adventurer (Shia La Beouf) must ferret out a powerful artifact and keep it out of the hands of a deadly Soviet agent (Cate Blanchett).

showtimewest.us.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
showtimewest.us.description: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

showtimewest.us.title: Rush Hour
showtimewest.us.description: A Hong Kong detective and a wisecracking L.A.P.D. detective choose to work together to find the missing daughter of a Chinese diplomat.

showtimewest.us.title: Rush Hour 2
showtimewest.us.description: Two detectives (Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker) battle a Hong Kong gangster (John Lone) and his henchmen after a bombing at the U.S. Embassy.

showtimewest.us.title: Rush Hour 3
showtimewest.us.description: The assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

showtimewest.us.title: The November Man
showtimewest.us.description: An ex-CIA agent (Pierce Brosnan) comes out of retirement to protect a valuable witness (Olga Kurylenko) and soon learns that now he is the target of his former friend and protégé (Luke Bracey).

showtimewest.us.title: Side Effects
showtimewest.us.description: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

showtimewest.us.title: Colossal
showtimewest.us.description: When a giant creature starts destroying Seoul, South Korea, a woman learns that she is somehow connected to the phenomenon. She must now figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world.

showtimewest.us.title: End of Sentence
showtimewest.us.description: After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

showtimewest.us.title: Parasite
showtimewest.us.description: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between the wealthy Park family and the destitute Kim clan.

showtimewest.us.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
showtimewest.us.description: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

showtimewest.us.title: Godzilla
showtimewest.us.description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

Among those who must battle the angry aquatic killing machine are marine biologist Kathryn Morgan (Bess Armstrong), her co-worker Mike Brody (Dennis Quaid) and a pair of friendly dolphins. 365blk.us.title: Ghosts of Mississippi
365blk.us.description: In this film based on actual events, black activist Medgar Evers is murdered in 1963, and much of the evidence points toward white supremacist Byron De La Beckwith. However, after two trials, De La Beckwith is acquitted twice by a jury of whites. Now, decades later in 1989, Evers' widow, Myrlie, thinks she has evidence to finally convict him. But no lawyer will touch the case except the young and brash Bobby DeLaughter. (Historical drama) - 1996

365blk.us.title: Torque
365blk.us.description: When biker Cary Ford (Martin Henderson) discovers some motorcycles filled with crystal meth, he stows them away. But it turns out that villainous gangster Henry James (Matt Schulze) has plans to recover his drugs. James frames Ford for the murder of Junior (Fredro Starr), the brother of Trey (Ice Cube), who heads the Reapers, a notoriously malicious biker gang. Ford goes on the run in an attempt to clear his name, while the FBI and multiple groups of motorcycle-mounted marauders chase after him. (Action) - 2004

365blk.us.title: Lethal Weapon
365blk.us.description: Following the death of his wife, Los Angeles police detective Martin Riggs (Mel Gibson) becomes reckless and suicidal. When he is reassigned and partnered with Roger Murtaugh (Danny Glover), Riggs immediately clashes with the older officer. Together they uncover a massive drug-trafficking ring. As they encounter increasingly dangerous situations, Riggs and Murtaugh begin to form a bond. Riggs' volatile behavior might just help them apprehend the criminals -- if it doesn't kill them both first. (Action, Thriller) - 1987

365blk.us.title: Passenger 57
365blk.us.description: John Cutter (Wesley Snipes) is a former policeman flying to Los Angeles to start his new job working for the anti-terrorism unit of a major airline. However, apprehended terrorist Charles Rane (Bruce Payne) is on the flight, too, being transported by the FBI. After Rane's accomplices kill the FBI agents and free him, Cutter realizes the entire flight is in danger. With the help of flight attendant Marti Slayton (Alex Datcher), Cutter tries to capture Rane and free the passengers. (Action) - 1992

cbsaustin.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler.

cbsaustin.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under
cbsaustin.us.description: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia."

cbsaustin.us.description: Renowned veterinarian Dr. Chris Brown brings viewers along on rare educational adventures while he visits places all around the globe. Dr. Chris' commitment to animal care extends to environmental stewardship, and it's with this in mind that he embarks on a journey that sees him taking on exhilarating experiences that range from hiking in a volcano to swimming with humpback whales. As Dr. Chris immerses himself in culturally diverse destinations, he takes care to uncover each region's best-kept secrets.

Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place. (Science fiction) - 1992

With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men. (Thriller, Historical drama, War) - 2002

filmriseaction.us.description: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa. (Action, Thriller, Crime drama, Mystery) - 2015

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: Lucky Dog: Paws With Purpose
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: Animal trainer Brandon McMillan matches deserving dogs with military members and families, highlighting how the bond between people and animals can provide comfort, companionship and stability. Along the way, viewers learn about the unique experiences of service members and military families and how qualities such as discipline, patience, teamwork and trust play an important role in both military life and successful dog training. The series features Smoky, a certified therapy dog and USAA's new K9 ambassador and chief pawsitivity officer, alongside her handler, Chris, an Air Force reservist and former military working dog handler. cbsphiladelphia.us.title: Lucky Dog: Down Under
cbsphiladelphia.us.description: Host Brandon McMillan showcases the heartwarming stories of Australian shelter dogs as they transition from rescue and rehabilitation to cherished members of loving families. Whether it's a scrappy terrier, an energetic kelpie or a partially deaf cattle dog, audiences discover that second chances can transform lives on both ends of the leash. This original series is based on the hit international format "The Dog House Australia." (Animals)

cbsphiladelphia.us.title: Hope in the Wild

Hope's passion for wildlife conservation shines through everything she does as she and her team go on difficult missions to care for and return each animal to the wild. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Pune vs Chennai - Day 11 Tie 1
pickletv.us.description: S2 E20 Witness a high-stakes showdown on the final day of league competition as the undefeated Chennai Super Champs face off against a determined Pune United squad in a battle for postseason momentum. The atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden is electric, featuring a "lip-smacking" women's singles battle between European stars Katie Morris and Dominika Turkovic. As Pune fights to stay alive in the tie, coach Rusty Sobeck looks for a breakthrough in a tactical mixed doubles clash against Jonny Goldberg’s top-tier rotation. From "stunning singles fight backs" to a strategic masterclass in doubles positioning, this tie showcases the intense grit required to challenge the league's only unbeaten titan.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 : US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Agassi/Waters vs. Petrouleas/Dussault
pickletv.us.description: S1 E7 The match features the second-seeded team of Anna Leigh Waters, the world's number one ranked women's player and a Triple Crown winner, and Andre Agassi, an eight-time Grand Slam tennis champion making his pro pickleball debut. They face the young team of Stevie Petruleas (13 years old) and Tristan Dassault (16 years old), who are playing in only their third tournament together and are looking to make their mark against the seasoned pros. The match highlights key plays, including Agassi's powerful two-handed backhand and Waters' quickness at the kitchen line, and showcases the dynamic between these experienced and rising stars in the sport.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional : Semifinals - Virginia vs. Florida
pickletv.us.description: S2024 E1 Witness a clash of collegiate giants as the University of Virginia and the University of Florida battle for a spot in the finals at Performance Pickleball RVA. The intensity is at an all-time high after Florida's grueling "dream breaker" victory over NC State to reach this stage. Elite talent takes center stage, featuring former D1 tennis stars like Laura Font and Norwegian standout Martinez Sunstein facing off against Virginia’s deep roster of defending champions. From powerful serves to tactical kitchen play, every point counts in this high-stakes quest for a championship bid.

Watch as tactical masters like Dusty Boyer and Jack Foster battle for supremacy in a series of intense singles and mixed doubles competitions where every point counts toward the league standings. With game-changing "Pickle Plays" and atmospheric "drums" fueling the intensity, this tie is a masterclass in professional grit and strategic precision.

paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. rifftrax.us.title: RiffTrax Live: "Manos" the Hands of Fate
rifftrax.us.description: This is a completely new riff of “Manos” The Hands of Fate, the Texas-fertilizer-salesman-directed classic made famous by Mystery Science Theater 3000.

rifftrax.us.title: Attack Of The Supermonsters
rifftrax.us.description: When stop-motion dinosaurs meet anime superheroes, only one thing is certain: things are about to get dumb as hell! Join Mike, Kevin, and Bill for one of the most unique movies we've ever done, Attack of the Super Monsters!

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E01 Mixologist Fred and Carrie decide to venture outside of Portland and along the way they learn about the special art of love.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E03 Cool Wedding Spyke and Irys want an unconventional wedding; Toni and Candace have a book signing; dropped iPhone; no bag at the supermarket.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E04 Grover Brendan and Michelle try to get their son into a prestigious preschool; Keith and Dave take their rescued dog to a dog park.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E05 Cops Redesign The mayor of Portland asks Fred and Carrie for their help to give the police force a much-needed makeover.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E06 Cat Nap After achieving success by including their cat in their band, "Cat Nap" is kidnapped by an obsessed fan.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E07 Motorcycle Peter and Nance try to spice things up in their love life after someone calls Peter an old man; moving a harp.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E08 Feminist Bookstore 10th Anniversary A 10th anniversary party is thrown for Toni and Candace at the Feminist Bookstore, but a surprise guest shows up with her boyfriend.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E09 No Olympics Fred and Carrie convince the Mayor that the Olympics should be barred from Portland but quickly change their minds once they meet Olympian Greg Louganis.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S02 E10 Brunch Village Peter, Nance, Fred, Carrie, the Mayor and most of the city of Portland find a new brunch spot which annoys Toni and Candace.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E01 Winter in Portlandia It's wintertime in Portlandia and Peter and Nance struggle to keep off winter weight by cutting pasta from their diets; Candace's son visits Women and Women First bookstore for the holidays; a couple tries to keep their food cart in business.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E02 Take Back MTV Spyke and Iris join forces with a gang of former MTV stars to take back MTV from the Tweens; a group of frustrated college grads stage a protest on the dance floor; Sandra has a crush on a mysterious man in her meditation class.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E03 Missionaries The Mayor sends Fred and Carrie on a door-to-door mission to Seattle to recruit new citizens for Portland; pedicab driver hustles for clients; Peter and Nance prepare for the opening of their Bed and Breakfast with a visit to The Doily Shoppe.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E04 Nina's Birthday Nina goes to great lengths to throw an extravagant 32nd birthday party for herself. The day-long event is set to include activities ranging from horseback rides to sunrise yoga that will last well into the night. The party turns into a Tapas Dinner.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E05 Squiggleman Concerned parents Brendan and Michelle start a band that makes kids music; The Portland Nerd Council issues a Public Service Announcement; Malcom and Kris have an uncomfortable lunch at a vegan restaurant. The Feminist Bookstore hosts a comedy night.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E06 Off the Grid Following an environmental scandal, The Mayor steps down from office and moves off the grid; a dolphin discovers that plastic bags have been banned in Portland; musicians compete in a Battle of the Gentle Bands.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E07 The Temp A temp worker hopes to turn her stint as Interim Mayor of Portland into a full-time job with Fred and Carrie's help; a wedding is interrupted; local baristas draft a coffee shop manifesto; Kath and Dave struggle to find a table at a restaurant.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E08 Soft Opening Peter and Nance practice hosting friends at the soft opening of their bed and breakfast; a magazine features a local furniture maker in their Man Issue; steampunks attend a convention; Fred takes a love interest on a bold third date.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E09 Alexandra The City of Portland is overrun with art projects; Fred and Carrie's relationship is complicated by their roommate Alexandra; a movie theater sells artisanal concessions. Kath and Dave are concerned about the coyotes in their neighborhood.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E10 No-Fo-O-Fo-Bridge The Rats decide to move out of their newly-gentrified neighborhood; first-time parents read various child-rearing books; Gavin and his girlfriend go to the movies; Carrie and Alexandra have dinner at a communal table.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S03 E11 Blackout Electricity is shut off for the entire city as a result of unpaid bills at the Mayor's office; Peter and Nance have a mysterious guest at their bed and breakfast.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E01 Sharing Finances A young woman is haunted by very smart ghosts; Doug and Claire make a big commitment to one another; Kath and Dave make the most of fifteen minutes; Sandra finally finds a soul mate; Fred is visited by a Date Fact Checker.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E02 Ecoterrorists Ecoterrorists protest animal testing at a makeup company; Bryce and Lisa Rent it Out!; Toni and Candace have a car wash; Fred misses hip hop; Dave helps Kath get a good night's sleep.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E03 Celery A celery salesman goes to great lengths to have celery become more popular; 911 dispatchers assure callers that it's beets; The Order Grill is open for lunch; Carrie declares social bankruptcy; a fed up office worker wants to become a gutter punk.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E04 Pull-Out King A punk from the 1980s wakes up from a coma; an e-mail goes neglected; Nina has surprising news for Lance; Malcolm and Kris tailgate a "Prairie Home Companion" live show; Carrie dates a tax lawyer.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E05 Spyke Drives Nance is driven to the emergency room; Gavin questions a singer; Fred and Carrie have a garage sale; dinner guests are held hostage.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E06 Bahama Knights Carrie and Fred go home after a concert; Fred has an idea for a music documentary; Peter is reunited with his old band, The Bahama Knights and his ex-wife who is the lead singer.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E07 Trailblazers Toni and Candace coach a dance team; Kickstarter videos compete at a Film Festival; Toni and Candace coach the Portland Trail Blazers' dance team.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E08 Late in Life Drug Use Mr. Mayor plans a parade; Brendan decides to try drugs; Carrie's brother visits with his new boyfriend.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E09 3D Printer Mr. Mayor uncovers Portland's official 3D printer; Lance and Nina's lizard dies; Santa worries about the future of Christmas.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S04 E10 Getting Away Toni and Candace lead a feminist retreat for women in New Beaverton, Ohio; Peter and Nance go on a walking tour.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E01 The Story of Toni and Candace The origin of the feminist bookstore; a merger between two corporate book retailers pits Toni and Candace against one another in fierce competition to be head of the Chick Lit Department.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E02 The Fiancee Lance and Nina feel pressure when Lance's mom and her new boyfriend visit.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E03 Healthcare Medical solutions are sought when a series of health ailments occurs.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E04 Sea World The Eco terrorists travel to San Diego to take down their next target, SeaWorld.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E05 4th of July Kath and Dave decide to host an unforgettable 4th of July barbecue; the Mayor searches the deep Web for some very special fireworks.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E06 Fashion Quinn is recruited at Portland's Dollar Store as the face for their rebranding campaign; Spyke faces trial for making unlicensed Bart Simpson merchandise.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E07 Doug Becomes a Feminist Doug discovers that he is a male feminist; Sandra takes a rideshare for the first time.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E08 House for Sale Fred and Carrie's landlord moves into their house; Kath and Dave decide to buy a new home for their next renovation project.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E09 You Can Call Me Al Kath and Dave get a little frantic when they need to rehearse for a karaoke party.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S05 E10 Dead Pets Police start profiling people that are considered odd after arsonists burn down a taxidermy shop.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E01 Pickathon The Flaming Lips headline Portland's Pickathon Music Festival; Brendan and Michelle attend the festival via drone.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E02 Going Gray Fred wakes up with gray hair and sets out on a journey to figure out how old he is; the Mayor reminds Carrie about an arrangement they made.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E03 Shville Fred wants to do something big with his life so he moves to Austin; Carrie experiences motherhood.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E04 Weirdo Beach The Weirdos decide to go to the beach, but issues arise when their hearse breaks down; an office worker is annoyed because his co-workers want to use his new charger.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E05 Breaking Up Claire has had enough of Doug's behavior and breaks up with him; Claire and Doug date new people and discover surprising things about themselves.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E06 TADA Kath and Dave's accident leaves them temporarily disabled and feeling insignificant; a car service app user dodges surge pricing by calling a cab.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E07 Family Emergency Louis C.K. cancels a show in Portland due to a family emergency; Fred and Carrie are asked to judge a plume contest.

portlandia.us.title: Portlandia
portlandia.us.description: S06 E08 First Feminist City Portland is declared the most feminist city in the country and Toni and Candace try to deal with all the attention; the town opens a Femi-Mart.

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
shadesofblack.us.description: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1994

shadesofblack.us.title: In the Heat of the Night: By Duty Bound
shadesofblack.us.description: A murder suspect (Corbin Bernsen) works for a businessman running against Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) for sheriff. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1995

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly
shadesofblack.us.description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. (Crime drama, Thriller, Music) - 1998

shadesofblack.us.title: Belly 2: Millionaire Boyz Club
shadesofblack.us.description: After eight years in prison, G (Jayceon Taylor) is released and returns to his old ways on the streets -- until he starts to fall for a policewoman (Shari Headley). (Drama) - 2008

shadesofblack.us.title: The Inspection
shadesofblack.us.description: A young, gay Black man with few options for his future decides to join the Marines, willing to do whatever it takes to prove himself to his estranged mother and triumph in a system that would otherwise cast him aside. However, even as he battles deep-seated prejudice and the grueling rigor of basic training, he finds unexpected camaraderie, strength and support in this new community, giving him a hard-won sense of belonging that shapes his identity and forever changes his life. (Drama, LGBTQ) - 2022

shadesofblack.us.title: The Island
shadesofblack.us.description: When his brother is killed, LAPD officer Mark leaves the city to return to the island he grew up on. Seeking answers and vengeance, he soon finds himself in a bloody battle with the corrupt tycoon who's taken over the island paradise. (Drama, Action, Thriller) - 2023

shadesofblack.us.title: Blood Brother
shadesofblack.us.description: A recently released convict takes murderous revenge against his childhood friends who let him take the fall for their crimes. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2018

shadesofblack.us.title: Falcon Rising
shadesofblack.us.description: A former Marine (Michael Jai White) travels to Brazil to hunt down the brutal Japanese mobsters who attacked his sister and left her for dead. (Action, Adventure, Martial arts, Thriller, Drama) - 2014

shadesofblack.us.title: Triple Threat
shadesofblack.us.description: A crime syndicate places a hit on a billionaire's daughter, making her the target of an elite assassin squad. A band of down-and-out mercenaries protects her, fighting tooth and nail to stop the assassins from reaching their target. (Action, Martial arts) - 2019

shadesofblack.us.title: Freelancers
shadesofblack.us.description: The son (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) of a fallen police officer joins the NYPD, where he falls in with his father's former partner and a band of rogue cops. (Action, Crime drama) - 2012

truehistory.us.title: The Celtic World - Who Are the Celts?

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - San Fran Summer of Love
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Three Amigos
tastemadetravel.us.description: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
tastemadetravel.us.description: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Highland Fling
tastemadetravel.us.description: The trio heads to Scotland as Gordon prepares to cook a feast for the chief of Clan Ramsay and his friends. Gordon shows the others how to dress like real Scotsmen as they go in search of Scottish beef, hunt for scallops and play some Highland Games. (Cooking, Travel) - 2025-09-05

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Brokeback Mountain
tastemadetravel.us.description: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - What Happens in Vegas
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favourite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chilli Crab Claws. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Bangkok's Night Market
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
tastemadetravel.us.description: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties. (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia - Jakarta's King of Street Food
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food". (Cooking)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes! (Cooking) - 2020-02-24

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-03

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
tastemadetravel.us.description: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants. (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-10

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Savoury Vietnamese Pancakes in Huė
tastemadetravel.us.description: Luke visits Huế - famous for its heritage and cuisine - and Con Hen Village to learn a technique for de-shelling baby clams, searches for best bowl of spicy beef noodle soup, and stops by a business where they make turmeric vermicelli noodle salad! (Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-17

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The Italian Job
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip - The French Connection
tastemadetravel.us.description: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to France, where Fred has been asked to co-host an Oyster Festival in the beautiful Arcachon Bay, in just four days' time. Reunited with their campervan, Fred nominates himself as the driver in his homeland. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Hand-Crafted Pasta in Puglia
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemadetravel.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemadetravel.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli. (Cooking, Travel)
